title: Hourly Devil-Corp Auto-Dig:Credico Chicago location and news scan
summary: Dataset-first hourly pass enriching Credico location semantics and recording a bounded current-news scan without filler.

data.research_question: What is the finest defensible current public location for Credico, and does current news add material evidence to the Devil-Corp parent-network target?
data.method: Enumerated 27 physical digs roots on current main. Excluded free-range as the planner meta-root and excluded cloarida, trump-netanyahu, and cia as the previous three successful hourly selections, leaving 23 eligible dataset/topic roots:canada-policy-influence, dark-academia, devil-corp, drunk-drivers, dnc, fed, flock, gop, graphika, greater-israel, hunter-biden, larry-fink, lexisnexis-risk-state-surveillance, occrp-aleph, offshore-leaks, palantir, tech-bro, trump-thiel-circle, us-israel-military-integration, usaid-doge-mortality-accountability, violent-offenders, wef, wef-columbus. Dataset seed 17838918006904147153 was derived from SHA-256(e40ac4d096e4ee41ef7c9bfd8a095ea28165de66|2026-08-18T17:00:00Z|hourly-auto-dig|dataset-first-v1) and selected devil-corp uniformly at dataset stage. The current executable packet loader recognizes plain JSONL, single gzip/base64 packets, and .parts manifests; the legacy Devil-Corp UK office directory contains .part-* files without a .parts manifest and therefore is not part of the current Free-Range-loaded frontier. The selected dataset has one connector-verifiable Free-Range-visible active target:starintel:investigation-target:devilcorp-network-root. Target seed 14868317128897890483 selected that sole target; a seeded choice over its four seed organizations selected starintel:org:credico for the HQ/location slice. Current Credico contact material publishes 550 W. Van Buren St., Suite 1100, Chicago, IL 60607 as its Chicago location. Current LinkedIn material labels Chicago, Illinois as headquarters and the street as the primary location; a 2022 first-party Credico release says it relocated its Chicago headquarters. The street is therefore modeled as a public organizational office and Chicago as headquarters locality, with no coordinates and no unsupported street-HQ promotion. After location enrichment, current official press/profile surfaces and broader 2026 legal/news results were reviewed, including Baros v. Credico (USA), LLC, Ninth Circuit No. 26-479. No material new August development with sufficient non-duplicate evidence was found, so no filler event or claim was created. An exact whole-corpus actionable-target total was not fabricated because connector indexing cannot reproduce the full executable DB+packet terminal-state, blocker, deduplication, and legacy-transport pass.
classification_rules: exclude the previous three successful hourly roots when alternatives exist
public office street address is not automatically headquarters
headquarters locality evidence does not establish a street-level headquarters designation
do not create current-news filler when no material non-duplicate evidence is found

findings.finding: Credico currently publishes 550 W. Van Buren St., Suite 1100, Chicago, IL 60607 as its Chicago location.
Current company-profile evidence identifies Chicago, Illinois as Credico headquarters locality.
Reviewed current evidence does not explicitly designate the current street address as headquarters.
The bounded August 2026 news scan produced no material non-duplicate event or claim suitable for ingestion.
